definition: Secret schemes designed to influence events or gain personal advantage.
author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
quote: He had been a provincial doctor; he had a civil appointment, and had no sooner taken it up than intrigues began.
example_sentence: The office was full of petty intrigues.
